purpose: Preserve project-original supporting-character identities while transferring to current KINETIC_CEL style

jobs.name: 唐胶
jobs.prompt: Use case: identity-preserving style-transfer. Image1 is the ONLY character identity and outfit source. Image2 is DRAWING STYLE ONLY: use its clean pressure-varied ink, broad controlled color planes, two-step hard cel shadows and moderate material detail. Do NOT copy image2's face, age, hairstyle, navy uniform or body proportions. Produce ONE independent dialogue character on a truly TRANSPARENT background, vertical 2:3 portrait canvas, top of complete hair through mid-thigh. Keep head, hair, both shoulders, elbows, hands and the named prop fully inside the sides with small margins; lower coat/apron may end at the bottom. Preserve the character's original face, attitude, silhouette, outfit design, dominant colors and accessory logic. Remove old photo-like grit, scratches all over the clothing, tiny noisy wear, vignette, cast shadow, black backdrop, bloom and halo; preserve a few purposeful seams and material accents. No labels, words, typography, logos, borders or swatches. This is a restyling of an existing expressive character, not a generic redesign. Subject is Tangjiao: the original punk male model-kit craftsman. Keep the exaggerated tall swept-up BLACK hair with its RED streak and shaved patterned side, warm amber eyes, asymmetric confident toothy grin, ear hoops, dark studded choker and layered thin chains. Preserve black rolled-sleeve shirt, dark long workshop APRON with deep red side strips, red/ivory tool shoulder straps, belt and hanging black tool pouch, striped forearm tattoos, fingerless gloves. Keep one hand raised showing the same red/black pliers, the other relaxed at his pocket. His playful sharp face, large grin and maker identity are essential. Do not make him another solemn clean-uniform hero, remove his punk traits, or turn his work apron into a military coat. Pliers should have two metal jaws and plausible handles. No new tools or weapons.
